shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 2 'calendar|date' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,160p' src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json && npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4 peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils@2 peerDependencies --json'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json | head -60 && rg -n -C 3 'Required setup|Calendar|DatePicker' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -100 && rg -n -C 3 'Flex|Typography|Button view|DateTime' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json | head -60; rg -n -C 3 'Required setup|Calendar|DatePicker' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -100; rg -n -C 3 'Flex|Typography|Button view|DateTime' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json | head -30; rg -n 'dateTime|configure|createDateTime|DateTime' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts; rg -n 'dateTimeNow|dateTimeParse|settings|DateTime' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -60; cat src/App.tsx; cat index.html"
